line: Bitcoin is drifting higher on the day as fear-greed holds neutral, yet weekly losses and ETF outflows flag weakening conviction beneath the surface.

wire_top3.line: Brooklyn DA and FBI seized 112 servers, shut 241 websites in crypto fraud network that targeted Russian speakers with fake investment schemes.
European Banking Authority designated Circle's USDC as first 'significant' e-money token under MiCA, placing it under direct EU oversight.
Russia's central bank confirmed ban on peer-to-peer crypto trading effective July 1, 2027; all trades must route through state-approved intermediaries.
